\[

 \sqrt{(1-\rho)\widehat U_n}\right\}
 \longrightarrow

 <1-\alpha.
\]

This is a fixed-quota subclass converse for uniform inference, not a claim that independently selected nodewise transport optimizers are jointly realizable by one completion over an adaptive history tree.
